description: Standard horizontal base plate, frozen YZ recipe (DEV-053 P08 / BUG-032 / FEAT-008). Sketch on YZ (u=+Y, v=+Z, normal=+X) with offset 92.5, one open line (-116,0.5)->(116,0.5). depth=185 grows one-sided along the signed sketch normal (direction=negative -> -X from the offset plane), thickness=1 is the sheet gauge centered on the sketch line (in-plane perpendicular, v=+Z). Expected: bbox X[-92.5,92.5], Y[-116,116], Z[0,1], volume 42920 mm3, COG (0,0,0.5) and part thickness 1 mm. wall_contract.wall_face_ids reports the green/white wall faces and is the only authority for which faces a flange may attach to. IMPORTANT (BUG-103): the 2026-10-31 feedback built this exact recipe and got only the X=+-92.5 short edges on the wall contour while both Z=0 long edges reported ProSmtedgeContourGet -8, so do not assume all four lower edges can carry a flange. Read wall_contour_status (eligible/ineligible/unknown) for every candidate edge on the current revision before promising four walls; the attribution question is tracked in BUG-103. Always confirm via wall_contract.frame and wall_face_ids, and select edges by geometry from the current inspection - never by a historical edge id.
